description: Bash is a shell language. It is useful for joining commands and automating small terminal jobs. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.
whatYouWillLearn: Name a set of commands with Bash
learningObjectives: Read an array item with Bash
Use a default value with Bash
